steps.expected: GET /admin/dashboard with no cookie lands on /admin/login

steps.step: wrong password shows the generic error
steps.expected: same sentence for a wrong password and an unknown email, no cookie set
steps.observed: both attempts: "Email or password is incorrect."; no session cookie

steps.step: login lands on the dashboard; cookie flags; no browser storage
steps.expected: HttpOnly + SameSite=Strict cookie, URL /admin/dashboard, storage empty
steps.observed: cookie HttpOnly=true SameSite=Strict Secure=false; localStorage and sessionStorage empty, no token in the URL, session cookie not readable by script

steps.step: dashboard shows every metric and the 50 INR target
steps.expected: all metric ids present, cost per student vs target
steps.observed: 7 per-site-day rows; cost status "Under target" (target 50 INR)

steps.step: Admins: create an admin, then set the role
steps.expected: new row appears, role change persists after reload
steps.observed: newbie@vc.test created as viewer, set to admin, still admin after reload

steps.step: Sources: set a secret; it never re-displays
steps.expected: state flips to 'set', the secret text is nowhere on the page, also after reload
steps.observed: 'not set' -> 'set'; secret text absent from the DOM after save and after reload; input cleared

steps.step: sign out returns to login and the cookie is gone
steps.observed: signed out; protected page redirects to login

steps.step: login; no Admins nav; /admin/admins is denied
steps.expected: Admins link absent, page says super-admin only, no API call made for the list
steps.observed: no Admins link; denied note shown

steps.step: Sites: add a site with origins; both keys shown once
steps.expected: reveal panel with vck_pub_ and vck_srv_ keys; gone after reload
steps.observed: pub and srv keys shown, then absent from the DOM after reload (only the prefix remains)

steps.step: Keys: rotate shows a new key once; old prefix replaced
steps.expected: confirm step, new key panel, new key differs, gone after reload
steps.observed: rotated pub key shown once and gone after reload

steps.expected: status badge revoked, rotate buttons gone; unrevoke restores

steps.step: Sources: add a GitHub source, Test, Sync
steps.expected: source appears; Test explains the missing secret; Sync reports ok
steps.observed: Test: "No secret is set for this source."; Sync: "Sync ok (files 42)"; no secret setter for admin

steps.step: stale role: a forced write returns 403 and the page shows it as an error
steps.expected: after the server downgrades the account, Add site shows 'not allowed' in an alert
steps.observed: banner: "You are not allowed to do that."

steps.step: lists visible, every write control absent or disabled
steps.observed: sites, site detail and sources render their lists; zero enabled write controls

steps.expected: POST /sites through the proxy with the viewer's token -> 403
after the API invalidates every token, the next navigation lands on /admin/login

steps.step: login page has no horizontal scroll
